lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in an ordered grid of approximately six horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal patterns of circular blobs, creating high-contrast grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the dorsal side and darker pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral boundary.
